sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_activity" monthly_member_activity_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', activity_month) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
